verdict.rationale: three.js has no built-in natural-language interface. Its only support is indirect: it publishes llms.txt, a 363 KB llms-full.txt and an explicit 'Instructions for Large Language Models' section, so third-party coding agents can turn natural-language requests into three.js code. The probe confirms there is no official or notable community MCP; agents drive the library directly through npm. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface (e.g. in the editor), an MCP server or other agent tool surface, and hands-on evidence of NL-driven operation.
